irs_submission.note: No IRS e-file, no CPA portal, no packing inside Ratio core. This app emits 8949-ish CSV from lot, wash, and lot-terms cites. Live submission stays leftover on #166 forever as a product door — it is not a kernel RPC.

grant_path.note: In-process /v1 accepts Connect catalog scopes after membership. Leftover on issue 22: API Gateway JWT authorizer still AuthKit-session only — a live Connect token can still 401 at the edge. Write-route actor binding landed (#151). This file leaves #150 and #166 open.

pooled_holding_period.note: When acquisition dates on a pooled holding disagree, the pack leaves the category unset. It does not invent FIFO's oldest date or two Form 8949 boxes. The kernel rule is Ratio.Lots.PoolPeriod — this file cites it; it does not invent a category of its own.
